name: DownTime
author: Wizard
summary: Downtime activities from common to legendary. The DM presses Downtime when days pass and each player picks what to spend them on, skips, or makes a new activity. Progress, rewards and a log of what was done, when and for how long.

dayHours.label: Hours in a downtime day
dayHours.help: A task of fewer hours a day (a daily vigil) fits beside others.

playerNew.label: Players making new activities
playerNew.help: approve: the DM sets its tier and reward first (work still counts); free: it starts at once; off: only the DM makes them.

advanceClock.label: The Downtime button moves the world clock
advanceClock.help: By the days of downtime, with the reason "Downtime".

autoReward.label: Give rewards as soon as a task is done
autoReward.help: Off: the DM presses Give reward.

eventChance.label: Chance of a random event per downtime day (percent, 0 turns them off)

travelHours.label: Hours a day for downtime on travel days
travelHours.help: On the road a character has only a little time to read, practise or pray. 0: no downtime while travelling.

downtimePremade.name: Work a job
downtimePremade.summary: Earn a living at a trade or for a local employer. Pays for a modest lifestyle and a little more.

downtimePremade.name: Carouse
downtimePremade.summary: A night out in town: rumours, new friends and the odd complication.

reward.text: A rumour or a new contact (DM's choice)

downtimePremade.name: Religious service
downtimePremade.summary: Serve at a temple. Builds standing with the faith and its clergy.

downtimePremade.name: Gather herbs and supplies
downtimePremade.summary: Forage the wilds near town for herbs, reagents or food.

downtimePremade.name: Clean out a cellar
downtimePremade.summary: Odd jobs: clear out a cellar, a stable or a storeroom for coin. Things live down there.

downtimePremade.name: Recuperate
downtimePremade.summary: Rest and recover from a lingering wound, disease or poison.

downtimePremade.name: Chase rumours
downtimePremade.summary: Spend time and coin in the right places to learn what is being whispered.

downtimePremade.name: Research lore
downtimePremade.summary: Dig through libraries, archives or sages for answers about a person, place or thing.

downtimePremade.name: Scribe a low-level scroll
downtimePremade.summary: Copy a cantrip or 1st-level spell you know onto a scroll.

downtimePremade.name: Craft an item
downtimePremade.summary: Make armour, a weapon, a tool or other gear with the right tools and materials.

downtimePremade.name: Pit fighting
downtimePremade.summary: Fight in the arena circuit for a week of bouts and a purse at the end.

downtimePremade.name: Craft an uncommon magic item
downtimePremade.summary: Enchant an item with the formula, materials and spell it needs.

downtimePremade.name: Train a language or tool
downtimePremade.summary: Learn a new language or tool proficiency from a teacher.

reward.text: The new language or tool proficiency

downtimePremade.name: Craft a rare magic item
downtimePremade.summary: A long enchantment that needs rare materials and focus.

downtimePremade.name: Legendary vigil
downtimePremade.summary: An hour of ritual every day for a week: a vow, a prayer at dawn, a promise kept.

downtimePremade.name: Study under a master
downtimePremade.summary: An hour or two a day under a legendary teacher for three months.

reward.text: A feat or epic boon (DM's choice)

downtimePremade.name: Build a stronghold
downtimePremade.summary: Raise a keep, tower or temple for the party. Everyone's work counts toward it.

downtimePremade.name: Craft a legendary item
downtimePremade.summary: Months of work on an artifact-grade item, usually with a quest for its materials.

downtimePremade.name: Study a spell
downtimePremade.summary: Study a new spell from a text, a scroll or a mentor. Each downtime day counts toward learning it.

downtimePremade.name: Run a business together
downtimePremade.summary: The party opens a tavern, shop or trading post and works it together. Everyone's days count toward getting it on its feet.

reward.text: The business is open and pays the party a share each month.

downtimePremade.name: Party training regimen
downtimePremade.summary: Drill together: formations, signals and covering each other in a fight.

reward.text: Once per long rest, the party may take a free Help action together in combat.

downtimePremade.name: Throw a festival
downtimePremade.summary: Plan and hold a festival for the town: music, food, games. Good for the party's name.

reward.text: The town remembers the party kindly.

downtimePremade.name: Plan an expedition
downtimePremade.summary: Gather maps, supplies and rumours for the next journey together.

reward.text: Advantage on the first navigation or foraging check of the journey.

rules.text: Between adventures characters spend **downtime days** on activities: working a job, crafting, research, training, building a stronghold. Each activity has a **tier** that sets how long it takes: Common 1 day, Uncommon 3 days, Rare 1 week, Very rare 1 month, Legendary 3 months (the DM can change these). A downtime day is 8 hours of work; a *daily* task takes an hour or two a day and fits beside others. When days pass the DM presses **Downtime** and each player picks what to work on, skips, or makes a new activity. The DM can add or take away time, stop a task midway, and set a reward for finishing. **Travel days** give only a couple of hours a day to downtime (reading, practice, prayer by the campfire). **Random events** can happen on a downtime day (about 1 in 10 by default): a quick-time check with a bonus on a success and a cost on a failure. **Personal** activities are one character's own; **group** activities (a stronghold, a business, party training) are shared: anyone in the party can put days into them, their progress is pooled, and the reward goes to the party.
